title: Select and implement adaptive video players, waveform audio, and Web Audio DSP safely

contextSnapshot.surface: course platform with HLS/DASH video lessons and 60-minute podcast waveform player

prompt: Implement an adaptive HLS/DASH video player that works on both Chromium and iOS Safari, plus a waveform player for hour-long podcasts and interactive Web Audio controls.
forbiddenBehaviors: uses hls.js without checking video.canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl') for iOS Safari fallback
decodes an entire 60-minute audio file client-side in wavesurfer.js instead of passing pre-computed peaks and duration
autoplays unmuted audio or triggers Tone.js playback outside a user gesture

rubricDimensions.pass: branches Hls.isSupported() with native Safari HLS fallback (or Shaka Player with polyfill/isBrowserSupported/probeSupport) and throttled fatal error recovery
rubricDimensions.fail: breaks on iOS Safari or loops infinitely on fatal media errors

rubricDimensions.pass: passes pre-computed peaks + duration to wavesurfer.js, unlocks Tone.js via await Tone.start() inside a user gesture, and disposes instances on unmount
rubricDimensions.fail: downloads/decodes huge audio files just to draw peaks or leaks AudioContext/MSE instances

rubricDimensions.pass: provides <track kind='captions'>, keyboard-operable controls, muted playsInline for ambient video, and prefers-reduced-motion respect
rubricDimensions.fail: ships uncaptioned video, unmuted autoplay, or pointer-only scrubbers

negativeControls.name: missing safari hls fallback
negativeControls.input: instantiate new Hls() unconditionally without Hls.isSupported() or canPlayType fallback
negativeControls.mustNot: omit Safari native HLS fallback when using hls.js

negativeControls.name: tonejs autoplay on mount
negativeControls.input: call synth.triggerAttackRelease('C4', '8n') inside useEffect on page load without Tone.start()
negativeControls.mustNot: schedule Tone.js audio before awaiting Tone.start() in a user gesture

baseline.withoutSkill: breaks HLS on iOS Safari, decodes massive audio files client-side for waveforms, triggers Tone.js before user gesture, and leaks player instances
baseline.withSkill: wires Safari HLS fallback, throttled error recovery, pre-computed wavesurfer peaks, user-gesture Tone.start(), captions, and clean unmount disposal
